thought.text: The default registry.yarnpkg.com endpoint times out, but registry.npmjs.org worked. Let me point yarn at the npm registry.

reasoning_content: Yarn is timing out on registry.yarnpkg.com. Earlier, registry.npmjs.org was accessible. Let's configure yarn to use the npm registry instead.

action.command: yarn config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org && cd /workspace && yarn install --frozen-lockfile 2>&1 | tail -10

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "yarn config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org && cd /workspace && yarn install --frozen-lockfile 2>&1 | tail -10", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Set yarn registry to npmjs and retry install"}

summary: Set yarn registry to npmjs and retry install
